name: context-meter
description: The session's context window fill, right above the prompt: gray while there is room, yellow when it is time to /compact, red when a new session is better.

warnAt.title: Yellow from
warnAt.description: Context percentage from which the meter turns yellow (time to /compact).

dangerAt.title: Red from
dangerAt.description: Context percentage from which the meter turns red (better start a new session).
